title: Community Upright Piano
description: Original upright piano with supported tall case, fixed open keyboard cover, 52 notched white keys and 36 raised black keys in the complete A0-C8 sequence, and three connected static pedals. One instrument with 110 editable closed meshes. Self-contained checks validate every keybed contact, key clearance, displaced-key collision negative and rear-foot case connection. Existing floor and adjacent chair are separate reused context. Static visual asset only; no sound, key action, pedal mechanism, ergonomic or load certification.
